title: The Brain Atrophy
body:
Earlier humans used to spend way more time learning and doing things which would made them actually productive and would get delayed gratification and dopamine. But year by year we are dwelling into the feeling of dopamine so much that we continue to engage in things that are not even healthy anymore. 

This involvement in unhealthy activities which gives instant gratification is reducing are ability to think properly. We as humans would prefer things which are highly rewarding to dopamine system even if the actual activity isn't unhealthy from the long term perspective like drugs, p*rn and doomscrolling.

Drugs might be an over the top example but nowadays there are things which are even more accessible like p*rn and doomscrolling which have same addiction patterns like drugs. But doomscrolling still sounds better than doing drugs lmao.

The term doomscrolling was first introduced in 2018 during the covid but the habit of doomscrolling may have began after the launch of tiktok in 2016. Tiktok an endless scrollable collection of videos tailored to your interests  what could go wrong :). Though people didn't really feel this addictive pattern with tiktok like they did with instagram shorts.

Shorts where designed to be addictive and they actually feel addictive (to me xD).
